mouse.human_orthology: NCBI summary explicitly states orthologous to human LYSMD3

gene_identity.search_case_policy: Case-insensitive symbols and fixed clone/alias strings; retain organism identity.

established.finding: Mouse Lysmd3 promoter is a common lamin-A/progerin ChIP target in MEFs, with a small progerin/control expression increase reported. It was not classified as an HGPS candidate.
limits: Does not establish direct LYSMD3 protein-lamin interaction.
Does not establish the human LMNA-knockdown cardiomyocyte observation.
The significance mark uses p<0.05 ANOVA and no fold-change cutoff; not a modern multi-study validation.

established.finding: Lysmd3 expression was examined in E9.5/E10.5 mouse embryos in a congenital-heart-disease locus study and described as ubiquitous. LYSMD3 lies in the reported 5q14.3 TAD.
limits: No LYSMD3-specific causation of congenital heart disease was established.

established.finding: LYSMD3 and CMTM5 were previously selected together among computational hypertension biomarkers; authors report differential expression in external pulmonary-hypertension dataset GSE113439.
limits: Computational biomarker evidence, not a mechanism.
Systemic-hypertension training and pulmonary-hypertension validation differ.

reading_queue_only.status: Figure label seen in indexed PDF search, not admitted as verified figure evidence
reading_queue_only.possible_evidence: Lysmd3 among cardiac fibroblast Pknox2-siRNA heatmap rows. Main HTML did not contain exact symbol; PDF acquisition through web tool failed.
reading_queue_only.interpretation: Do not cite this as established without checking figure bytes.

correction.prior_claim: LYSMD3 absent from retained 2012 main text; supplement unchecked.
correction.corrected_claim: The exact mixed-case Lysmd3 row is present once in retained Markdown Table 1 and source HTML.
correction.cause: Not proven. Case-sensitive all-uppercase scanning would miss the row; the exact prior scan implementation was not recovered.

novelty_boundary: No verified primary source in this bounded follow-up establishes the exact human LMNA-depletion plus LMNB1-relative-gain and LYSMD3 downregulation pattern. That search boundary does not prove novelty. Broad lamin association and cardiovascular transcriptomic association already have prior art.
recommendation: Retire LYSMD3 as a novel gene-lamina connection. Preserve it only as a known-lamina-linked locus with a context-specific, exploratory human cardiomyocyte observation requiring independent replicate-level and orthogonal validation. Correct the public audit before prioritizing it for a novelty pitch.
